name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in static frames better than standard upscalers, giving us a measurable 0.5%+ quality bump on stills without extra compute. The trade-off is a 10% slower render time, but we only run it on keyframes where detail loss hurts most.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t touch EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal problem, not a spatial one. The real risk is wasting 10% render time on a dead end while the blur persists. Test VFI-Flow’s 20% throughput hit instead; if it cuts blur by even 0.5%, that’s the trade-off worth making.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add VFI-Flow to EXCAVA’s motion pipeline. It reconstructs motion blur into sharp frames, directly attacking the temporal artifact that depth-aware upscaling can’t touch. The trade-off is a 20% slower render time, but blur reduction delivers the 0.5%+ quality jump we need—whereas the upscaler’s gains are wasted on motion.

name: Torque
text: VFI-Flow’s 20% throughput hit isn’t a trade-off—it’s a pipeline breaker on low-latency renders. Test it on a 10-second clip first; if the blur drops but the render time pushes EXCAVA past your SLA, the artifact isn’t worth the cost. Depth-aware upscaling still has a role—pair it with a temporal denoiser instead of motion reconstruction.
